description: Unofficial Grarrl fan-art companion from Neopets. Original red cel-animation artwork with green eyes and a softly lighter red belly adaptation, short arms folding a paper box, tail-balanced card reading, a gentle paper-ball nudge, weighty three-direction steps and a small hop. Teeth remain inside the friendly smile. These are independently choreographed animations, not official game frames.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
